subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a TUI send/newline keybinding preference, or narrow this issue to documenting the existing pi-tui defaults and fallbacks?
rationale: The current dependency already provides multiline composition, while adding a preference would create new config/keybinding surface under OpenClaw's high config bar.

options.title: Document Existing Defaults
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback behavior while preserving the current dependency-owned keybindings.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Expose a narrow TUI send/newline preference with schema, help, docs, and focused PTY coverage after accepting the config/API maintenance cost.

options.title: Defer To Broader Editor Work
options.body: Keep this open under a broader TUI editor ergonomics decision alongside external editor and vi-mode requests.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Defaults
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback behavior while preserving the current dependency-owned keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner for the TUI wrapper, docs/help surface, and dependency pin that determine the product boundary here.
